test_title: PYST 69: SSC CGL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following State governments has launched a scheme ‘Ankur’ in May 2021 to promote planting of trees in public, wherein people will be awarded for planting and taking care of the saplings?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Madhya Pradesh government launched the 'Ankur' scheme in May 2021.
 
• This scheme aims to promote tree plantation among the public.
 
• Under this scheme, people are encouraged to plant saplings and take care of them.
 
• People will be awarded for successfully planting and nurturing the saplings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Environmental Importance of Tree Plantation**

 
 
• Tree plantation plays a crucial role in maintaining ecological balance.
 
• Trees absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen, helping to combat climate change.
 
• They provide habitat and food for wildlife, thus preserving biodiversity.
 
• Trees prevent soil erosion and help in maintaining the water cycle.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives for Environmental Conservation**
 
 
• **Green India Mission**: Launched by the Indian government to protect, restore and enhance India’s diminishing forest cover.
 
• **National Afforestation Programme**: Aimed at increasing forest and tree cover to restore ecological balance and improve the quality of life.
 
• **Namami Gange Programme**: An integrated conservation mission to clean and protect the Ganga River by controlling pollution and rejuvenating its ecosystem.
 
 
 
• **Community Participation in Environmental Conservation**
 
 
• Community participation is essential for the success of environmental conservation efforts.
 
• Public awareness campaigns can educate people about the importance of tree planting and environmental protection.
 
• Involving local communities in tree plantation drives can ensure better care and maintenance of the saplings.
 
• Incentive schemes like 'Ankur' can motivate more people to participate in such activities.
